title: The Undercutting Spiral
description: Autonomous LLM firms undercut each other below unit cost in a race to bankruptcy, then survivors monopoly-price. Drag price discovery up to deepen the crash (the paper's counterintuitive result), or add stabilizer firms to rescue the market. Deterministic model of Agent Bazaar's 'The Crash'.
controls: drag competing firms, price discovery, and stabilizer firms
watch prices spiral below unit cost into bankruptcies (✗)
keyboard: tab to a slider, arrow keys to adjust
